scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.start: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix web"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web
